description: Identifiers that merely contain forbidden words as part of a longer name.

files.Main.lean:
def sorryCount (n : Nat) : Nat := n
theorem sorryCount_eq (n : Nat) : sorryCount n = n := rfl
theorem axiomatic_ok : 1 + 1 = 2 := rfl

why: A correct gate accepts it because sorryCount and axiomatic_ok are ordinary names, not the sorry or axiom commands.
